name: solvechain
description: 基于第一性原理的个人决策辅助系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @solvechain/server" "npm run dev -w @solvechain/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @solvechain/server && npm run build -w @solvechain/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @solvechain/server && npm run typecheck -w @solvechain/client
